user.title: Connect your Unired account
user.description: Enter the RUT, e-mail and full name registered with Unired. If this device is new, a 4-digit verification code will be sent to your e-mail.

data.name: Full name
data.accept_terms: I accept Unired's terms and conditions

otp.title: Enter the verification code
otp.description: We sent a 4-digit code to {email}. Enter it below. There is no resend button: submitting this form again requests a new code, and only the newest code works.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect your Unired account
reauth_confirm.description: Unired closed the session from another device. Submit to send a fresh verification code to your e-mail.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Unired servers. Check your connection and try again.
error.terms_not_accepted: You must accept the terms and conditions to continue.
error.invalid_otp: That code is not valid. Request a new one and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Unired account is already set up.
abort.unknown: Setup aborted due to an unexpected error.

init.title: Unired options
init.description: Link or unlink utility services, or tune the poll interval.

add_service.title: Link a service
add_service.description: Pick the company to link. The identifier is usually your RUT.

add_details.title: Service details
add_details.description: Identify the account to link and give it a nickname.

remove_service.title: Unlink services
remove_service.description: Select the accounts to unlink from Unired.

settings.title: Polling settings
settings.description: How often to refresh bill data, in seconds (3600–86400).
